sourcing.note: Every service here is inferred, and none reaches confirmed. The Bengaluru-Hampi pair comes from a route-aggregator page reached only through a search summary; the direct fetch failed with a DNS error and was not independently re-verified. The Bengaluru-Chennai corridor's distance, running time, classes and boarding points are secondary-sourced, and the three departure times cited are very likely a subset of the real timetable rather than all of it. No output may present any of these times as a published timetable. The reservation fee and toll figures are this repository's own; what is the operator's own published policy is that the fee is non-refundable in every slab and the toll is refunded in full in every slab, which is why the two are separate fields.

services.operatingCorporationNote: Hosapete is in Ballari district and Hampi in Vijayanagara district, both Kalyana Karnataka territory, and yet the three corporations share one reservation brand and portal and run their premium classes jointly. No primary source establishes which corporation dispatches this nightly Majestic-origin coach. Absence means unknown, and unknown must render as absent rather than as the brand.
services.popularityNote: A fidelity dial, not a claim. No route-level ridership data exists for these corporations, so this number is authored rather than derived. It is set high because an overnight sleeper to a destination people travel to on purpose fills better than a daytime seater.

services.operatingPatternNote: Six days rather than seven, so that the fixture set contains a date on which a corridor genuinely does not run. A rider asking about a Saturday gets no item for it, and no roll-forward to the Sunday. Nothing in the research says this service does not run on Saturdays.

services.generatedNote: No real, numbered Tatak working exists for FLYBUS on any corridor - confirmed by scanning every data/intercity/*/trips.txt route named FLYBUS, all zero (see FT-INVENTED.json's own note). Tatak's own src/intercity/classes.ts FLYBUS entry places the real product at Bengaluru airport (BIAL) to Mysuru/Madikeri/Coimbatore/Kundapura, but BIAL has no boarding point anywhere in this project (Tatak's own ka-bng-mng corridor notes already refuse the same working for the same reason), so this generated service substitutes Majestic for BIAL and keeps Madikeri, one of the four real destinations that entry names. The fare (1070 rupees) is fully computed - this project's own cross-corridor tariff line (23 + 1.27 rupees per road km, the same formula Tatak's own generator uses for its I-grade cells), over an estimated 271 road km (208 km straight-line x1.3, since no road-routing figure was found), times FLYBUS's own fareMultiplier (2.91) from Tatak's classes.ts. Nothing about this service - its number, its departure time, its running time, its fare - was observed; every field is this repository's own invention, authored only so the class is sellable rather than absent, per standing product direction.
services.popularityNote: A fidelity dial, not a claim, same as every other service in this fixture set - and doubly so here, since the service itself is invented. Set at a plain mid-range figure with no signal either way to lean on.

services.generatedNote: No real, numbered Tatak working exists for AMOGHAVARSHA on any corridor - its one citation, ka-bng-bjp trip KA-BNG-BJP-OP-1945BNGIND, carries a real fare but tatak_departure_source/tatak_run_time_source are both 'generated' rather than 'sourced' and it has no tatak_service_number at all, so generate-ksrtc-fixtures.ts correctly drops it. This generated service is placed on that same corridor (Bengaluru-Vijayapura, the real Kalyana Ratha corridor this whole pass exists to fix), which is exactly where Tatak's own data already ties this class. The fare (1002 rupees) is the real number KSRTC's own page states for this pair and class (docs/research/sources/ksrtc-bng-vijayapura-2026-09-07.tsv, graded V in Tatak's own fare_products.txt) - reused here because it is the best real figure on hand, but graded I rather than V in this fixture, because the schedule carrying it (departure time, running time, the service number) is this repository's own invention, not the trip that fare was published against. Boarding and dropping points mirror KALYANA_RATHA's own real pattern on this identical corridor (Majestic, Yeshwanthpur, Peenya, Tumakuru, Chitradurga, Hosapete, Vijayapura) rather than a bare two-point run, both because Tatak's own domain research places Amoghavarsha on exactly this road and because the multi-point shape is what every genuinely-sourced service in this fixture set already looks like - see this provider's own generate-ksrtc-fixtures.ts docblock on 'why this is no longer a two-point model'.
